Cross-block rank-one rigidity gives a shared unit scalar with >=3 classes; for exactly 2 classes all alternatives are reciprocal class scalars constrained by c_r(h) and the explicitly factored energy equation. The CAZAC examples attain nontrivial partners. The saved standalone checker independently verifies full A(u,v) levels and raw intensity equality/non-equality over p=5,7,11, but numerical work is not the proof.

value.rationale: For a natural unperturbed cubic-chirp window, a structural ambiguity obstruction known to prevent global phase retrieval is resolved precisely on every support meeting >=2 residue classes. The exact transition at 3 populated classes and the exceptional 2-class CAZAC energy swap solve a motivated natural fiber problem. Fully populated two-block signals exhibit nontrivial ambiguity, so this is not an isolated two-spike degeneracy; no unsupported downstream application is needed for the mathematical value.
